messages:
kevin: quick heads-up, found a routing + billing mismatch after a schema strictness canary. some invokes got sent to the degen path but billing counters didn't match dashboard. creating thread to triage.

sara: can you share the validator output and example request?

kevin: pasted an anonymized sample below. validator flagged an unexpected top-level field; router falls back to degen, but meter seemed to keep original route tag.
```
REQUEST: {
  "tool": "search",
  "args": {"q":"price per token"},
  "metadata": {"request_id":"r-12345","route":"route_prod_usw"},
  "extra": {"user_note":"debug"} // extra top-level field triggers strict reject
}
VALIDATOR: reject(reason=unknown_field:extra, mode=strict)
ROUTER: fallback_to=degen_route(usw, variant=cheap)
METER: ingest(route_id=route_prod_usw) then route swap -> outgoing events lost final route label
```

maria: so meter ingested initial route, but after the router swapped to degen we didn't re-annotate the final outbound metric? that would create the divergence.

kevin: yep. the degen path intentionally suppresses some billing labels as a safety measure, but in this case it produced inconsistent counts: heavy model billed, console showed degen usage. customers saw a spike.

ops-bot: alert: routing-fallback spike detected 2026-02-18T09:12:45Z — 312 fallbacks in 10m (us-west-2).

sara: immediate mitigations: 1) router hotfix to copy effective_route into meter event before emit, 2) backfill affected events for billing audit, 3) add transient metric route_swap_events.

kevin: I'm landing a small router hotfix to write final_route on the meter envelope. deploying to canary now.

tom: I'll add a console tile to show meter_count vs billing_count per route (simple time-series with delta). should be quick.

maria: longer-term: we need a contract: validator should emit an "effective_route_hint" when it forces fallback due to schema; router must guarantee final_route is present on all downstream telemetry and billing events; meter should prefer final_route over initial tags. also add a unit test in the meter pipeline to prevent dropping route tag on swap.

sara: also a policy note: degen must not escalate billed model class. it can only reduce cost. enforce cost_cap assertion in fallback policy. if fallback would increase cost, deny fallback and return explicit error.

kevin: good point. rollout UX: console should simulate "schema_strictness" flips and show projected fallback rate + projected billed token delta before toggling in canary. we didn't have that for yesterday's canary.

ops-bot: deploy-note: kevin/router-hotfix -> canary @6623456800, prod rollout paused.

sara: once hotfix is stable, please run the backfill job and publish job id here. customers will ask for reconciled invoices.

kevin: scheduled backfill job: job-20260218-01 (will post progress). will also file a short postmortem with timeline, affected customers, patch, and follow-ups.

maria: follow-ups: 1) add route_swap_events metric + alert, 2) add console ops table row for schema_reject->fallback ratio by route, 3) meter pipeline unit test to assert route_tag preserved, 4) run canary projection UI for strictness toggles.

kevin: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for updates; will post backfill progress and postmortem link.
